name: routecmd
description: 2.11BSD's route(8) on lo0, the only interface without a card: `route -n add' a host route through lo0's own address (metric 0: the gateway is this host), which a datagram to it then takes (ifcprobe -s: ip_output finds a route), `route -n delete' it, which takes the route away (ENETUNREACH, 51), and `route -f' after adding a net route, written as its network number 10.8, with metric 1 (RTF_GATEWAY, the only kind flushroutes deletes), which it finds through sysctl kern.netdata, nlist on /netnix and /dev/kmem, and deletes.
